name: The Knick Man
notes: Known from one ICWA sample served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/free-agent-1998-05-15.html: a 250-pound New Yorker in a blue Knick Man jersey who hires a fake reverend to pray over his opponent, wins the main event by a knee-breaking submission and cracks a bible over The Preacher.
caption: A blasphemous New Yorker who beats The Preacher with a prayer and a bible on the ICWA's first show.

name: The Preacher
notes: Known from one ICWA sample served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/free-agent-1998-05-15.html: a 327-pound Canadian from Godsville, Ontario, who enters in a white robe, fights from his knees and refuses to give up against The Knick Man.
caption: A 327-pound robed Canadian who is bested on the ICWA's first show.
